slides.content:
Open items from this week

  • Finance needs the revised vendor list before the budget freeze on the 14th
  • The data warehouse migration slipped one sprint; new cutover is November 3
  • Legal approved the new data-processing terms for EU customers
  • Two open roles in support engineering; one offer out
  • Customer advisory board confirmed for December 9 in Chicago
  • Mobile release 4.2 is blocked on the accessibility review
  • Security asked every team to rotate service credentials by month end
  • The partner portal redesign is ready for a pilot with three partners
  • Q4 hiring plan needs sign-off from each department head
  • Office move: desks are assigned, network install is scheduled
  • Usage-based pricing experiment ends Friday; results next week
  • Holiday on-call rotation still has two open weekends
  • Design review for the onboarding flow moved to Thursday
  • Board deck first draft goes to the CEO on the 21st
